subject: Recap: Executive discovery — NexaHealth strategic inference program
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Executive discovery — NexaHealth strategic inference program

Hi Sarah / Dr. Ortiz,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Wanted to capture the key points and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for your exec team. High level summary below.

Call attendees (captured): Sarah Jensen (NexaHealth, Dir. Digital Products), Dr. Michael Ortiz (NexaHealth, Exec Sponsor), Jordan Blake (Redwood Inference, Enterprise AE), Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood, Solutions), Aditya Rao (Redwood, Sales Engineer).

Top pain points we heard
- Inference cost is a barrier to expanding real-time clinical assistants across the org (current cost per request spikes at peak times).
- Tail-latency sensitivity for clinician workflows: target 95th p99 < 200ms for patient-facing flows.
- Data residency & HIPAA constraints: data must remain in your VPC for certain workloads; audit trails required.
- Ops friction around model lifecycle and verifying quality over time (false positives in sensitive prompts).

Goals / success metrics you shared
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~3x for batch/nearline workflows.
- Achieve p95 latency below 200ms for the pilot use-case.
- Pilot completed and validated with security sign-off by end of Q2 so Procurement can move to PO.

Procurement path / stakeholders
- Executive sponsor: Dr. Michael Ortiz (final sign-off on strategic spend).
- Procurement lead: please confirm but Sarah indicated she will introduce Lydia Park (procurement).
- Legal: expecting a DPA + limited redlines on data retention and access.

Proposed next steps (we agreed on these)
1) Redwood to share a short pilot proposal + TCO snapshot (attached). Target: 1-week turnaround.
2) Schedule a 60-minute architecture workshop with your infra/security team — propose Wed or Thu next week. Vanessa + Hannah will run this.
3) Security & compliance pack: SOC 2 report, data flow diagram, and a short answers doc for your questionnaire — we’ll attach to the HubSpot record.
4) Procurement introduction + high-level pricing for a 3-month Dedicated pilot (includes discount and trial credits).

Attachments: NexaHealth-exec-brief.pdf, MVP-scope.xlsx (pilot scope & acceptance criteria).

If anything above is off, please flag and I’ll update. Otherwise, Sarah — would you introduce Lydia + legal contact so we can include them on the pricing/DPA thread?
Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0167

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@nexahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Dr. Michael Ortiz <michael.ortiz@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Executive discovery — NexaHealth strategic inference program

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. This looks right to me. A few clarifications / asks from our side: 

- Please include a ballpark monthly cost for the pilot (we need a number to take to Lydia in procurement). High level units + expected tokens / requests is fine.
- Procurement lead: I’ll introduce Lydia Park (copied below once I confirm). She will want to see the DPA language and a clear risk statement.
- Legal: our counsel will want a vendor security questionnaire answered before we move forward. Can your security team fill the questionnaire and share SOC 2 evidence?
- Trial ask: Can you do a 3-month pilot on Dedicated capacity with a limited scope (pilot endpoints for 2 apps)? We’re open to a discounted model if we can validate latency and cost improvements.

Dr. Ortiz — appreciate joining briefly today; we’ll loop you in once we have the proposed pilot and costs.

Best,
Sarah Jensen
Director, Digital Products | NexaHealth
sarah.jensen@nexahealth.com | (617) 555-2244

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Executive discovery — internal next steps

Team — quick internal note to capture what we should prepare: 

- Pilot proposal: 3-month Dedicated pool, initial scope 2 endpoints (clinician triage + patient Q&A). Include 20% pilot discount and 30k credit to offset onboarding. See attached draft pilot-proposal.pdf.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 type II, short data flow diagram (we will redline their questionnaire). Hannah to own answers and the architecture workshop.
- Compliance option: offer Private (VPC) for protected PHI workloads and Hosted for non-PHI — call this hybrid deployment in the SOW.
- Pricing ask: produce a simple TCO table showing current vs projected monthly inference spend (baseline estimates + 3x cost improvement target). Jordan: we should call out expected token volumes and p95 latency SLAs in the deck.

I’ll iterate the pilot pdf and share a final version by EOD. Vanessa, can you run deck for the arch workshop? I’ll sync with Hannah on security questions.
Thanks,
Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference

(Attachment: pilot-proposal.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@nexahealth.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Dr. Michael Ortiz <michael.ortiz@nexahealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Executive discovery — NexaHealth strategic inference program

Sarah / Lydia / Dr. Ortiz — looping in Lydia per Sarah’s note. Thanks — Lydia, great to e-meet you.

To confirm next steps and dates: 
- We will deliver the final pilot proposal + TCO snapshot by Thursday, Mar 4 COB. (Attachment: pilot-proposal.pdf)
- Architecture workshop: propose Thu, Mar 4 10:00-11:00am PT. Agenda: deployment model (Private vs Dedicated), SSO/KMS options, data flow & logging, SLOs. Vanessa + Hannah + Aditya will lead.
- Security pack & questionnaire: Hannah will send the initial questionnaire responses and SOC 2 evidence by Friday, Mar 5.
- Procurement: we’ll include a one-page commercial summary for Lydia (expected monthly pilot price range + credits).

If the schedule works, I’ll send calendar invites and shared drive links with materials. Also please flag any non-starters in procurement or legal so we can escalate early.

Appreciate the partnership — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0167
